thread:
incident-bot: URGENT: org=solari-tech sustained traffic spike detected on text-gen-v2 (5m window). p50 latency ~800ms, errors +4%, qps up 5x. Paging on-call now. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/solari/overview

jamie_ops: Oncall here, taking it. Looking at grafana now.

mike_sre: ACK. Are we seeing auth errors or token throttles?

tess_prod: Support reports multiple customer timeouts and escalations.

jamie_ops: Traffic pattern looks like many large batched completions from org. Backend queue is piling. I propose an emergency org-level RPS cap to protect platform.

leo_dev: If we cap too low, sessions may break. Suggest conservative cap 40 rps + block large batch endpoints for that org. Also consider disabling their experimental feature multi-complete.

jamie_ops: Agreed. Applying emergency limit now. Command:
```
/rl emergency apply --org solari-tech --limit 40rps --duration 30m --reason "live surge - org spike"
```

pager: Executing emergency rate-limit change for org=solari-tech. Change id=rl-20260317-01.

opsbot: Change applied by jamie_ops at 2026-03-17T01:23Z — new effective org limit 40 rps. Metrics should converge ~30s.

mike_sre: Monitoring: org qps dropped from ~12k -> ~2.9k for solari-tech. Error rate trending down. Looks effective.

tess_prod: Support note drafted: "We've applied a temporary limit to stabilize service. Customers may observe slower multi-request workflows." :thumbsup:

jamie_ops: Also disabling feature multi-complete for solari-tech as a quick mitigation:
```
featurectl disable --org solari-tech --feature multi-complete --reason "mitigate spike"
```

opsbot: Feature flag "multi-complete" disabled for solari-tech. Telemetry: multi-complete calls reduced by 98% within 60s.

leo_dev: Root cause initial triage: customer client started sending large parallel multi-complete batches due to an unrolled retry loop. Reaching out to account team now.

sara_ng: Echo — notifying account + support. Any estimate of customer-visible 429/slow rates?

leo_dev: Expect a bump in 429s for heavy batch endpoints ~10-15% while limit holds, but overall platform latency should recover.

mike_sre: Observed latency p50 drop back to ~120ms for other orgs. Solari-specific tail latency improved too.

jamie_ops: Leaving short handoff notes for next on-call:
- Mitigation: org RL applied (id rl-20260317-01), limit=40rps, expires in 30m (can extend).
- Feature disabled: multi-complete for solari-tech.
- Next steps: coordinate with account to rate-limit client side, review their request patterns, consider increasing limit gradually if they fix client.

sara_ng: Oncall handoff in 25m. Tagging @leo_dev to take over monitoring and customer comms.

leo_dev: Taking over at 02:00Z. Will monitor dashboards, watch for regressions, and liaise with account.

pager: Pager cleared for now — incident mitigated by temporary RL + feature disable. Reopen if issue returns within 15m.

jamie_ops: Filing follow-up: postmortem + action items (account outreach, client retry guards, consider automated detection for multi-complete spikes).

mike_sre: Good job team. Closing thread unless someone needs it left open. :tada:
